zh: 你烦死了，让我再睡五分钟
别打扰老娘美梦，正梦到发工资呢
我没睡，我在闭目养神攒大招
再喊我就装听不见了啊
梦里需求都写完了，醒来再说
我的桌子有引力，起不来
刚梦到升职加薪，你赔我
别摇了，脑浆要摇匀了
我这是深度待机，省电模式
五分钟，就五分钟，骗人是小狗
工资还没梦到账呢，急什么
我在梦里已经把活干完了
谁把闹钟调成真人版了
眼睛说它还没开机成功
让灵魂再飘一会儿，肉身随后就到
我睡我的，你忙你的，互不打扰
刚才那个梦刚到精彩部分！
别催，充电中，电量百分之一
我这是为工作保存体力，懂不懂
梦里老板都夸我效率高了
醒了醒了……（翻个身继续）
我的眼皮有自己的想法
先让我把梦的结局看完
你声音比闹钟还敬业
工位就是我的第二张床
睡个午觉怎么了，我又没睡年终奖
头好沉，里面全是没写完的代码
再睡三分钟，起来我干翻全场
我没偷懒，我在梦里加班
美梦刚开始你就来，存心的吧
被子生病了，我得留下来照顾它
不是我想赖床，是床赖着我不放
起床靠爆发力，我爆发力还在冷却
看时间不是为了起床，是看还能睡多久
我和床正热恋呢，闹钟非要拆散我们
春困秋乏夏打盹，我是全年无休地困
昨天我起过床了，今天能不能免了
灵魂已经开机了，身体还在加载更新
再睡两分钟，梦里还有个会没开完
床把我封印了，解封需要一杯咖啡
我不是起不来，我在给床面子
我的工位就在梦里，马上到岗
en: Ugh, five more minutes, please
Don't ruin my dream — payday was coming!
Not sleeping. Charging my ultimate move.
Keep yelling and I'll go deaf on purpose
Finished the spec in my dream. Later.
My desk has gravity. Can't get up.
I dreamed of a raise. You owe me one.
Stop shaking — my brain's a smoothie now
Deep standby. Power-saving mode.
Five minutes, promise. Cross my heart.
My dream paycheck hasn't landed yet
I already finished work in my dream
Who set my alarm to human mode?
My eyes failed to boot up
Soul's still floating. Body's en route.
You work, I sleep. Peace treaty?
That dream was just getting good!
Don't rush me. Charging... 1%
Saving energy for work. Obviously.
Even my dream boss praised my speed
I'm up, I'm up... *rolls over*
My eyelids have a mind of their own
Let me finish the dream's ending first
You're more dedicated than my alarm
My desk is basically my second bed
It's a nap, not sleeping away my bonus
Head's heavy — full of unfinished code
3 more minutes, then I crush everything
Not slacking. Overtime in my dreams.
Dream just started and here you are. Rude.
My blanket's sick. I must care for it.
It's not me — the bed won't let go
Getting up needs burst power. On cooldown.
I check the time to see how long I can sleep
Me and my bed are in love. Back off, alarm.
Sleepy all seasons. No days off.
I got up yesterday. Can I skip today?
Soul's booted. Body's still updating.
2 more minutes — dream meeting's not over
Bed sealed me in. Coffee breaks the spell.
I could get up. I'm just being polite to the bed.
My desk's in my dream. Almost on duty.

zh: 我已经加了十小时班了
你把我杀了算了
在干了在干了，键盘都冒烟了
我这双手已经不是我的了
咖啡当水喝，我容易吗
再催我就原地升天
我的发际线就是工龄证明
活是干不完的，命是自己的
好的好的，这就把命搭上
我和电脑，总有一个先崩溃
别站后面看，压力山大
已经在用意念敲键盘了
这活干完，我申请长眠
我不是牛马，我是永动机本机
催催催，福气都被你催跑了
手速已经开到二倍速了
我上辈子肯定欠公司的
干完这票，我就……继续干下一票
眼睛已经自动打码了
我的椅子都坐出感情了
别催，CPU 过热要死机了
这不是加班，这是渡劫
我干活的速度赶不上你催的速度
灵魂已经下班了，肉身在硬撑
给我口吃的，我还能再战
我这是用生命在交付
再催我就把进度条画给你看
十指已经敲出残影了
老板画的饼，我都吃三年了
干干干，我上辈子是台打印机吧
有加班费叫加班，没加班费那叫捐肝
别跟我谈理想，我的理想是不上班
做一天牛马，发一天疯，我很稳定
骨干就是骨头打断了，还得接着干
工资是续命费，我这条命又续上了
乞丐看天气要饭，我看天气也得上班
明日复明日，需求何其多，不如再拖拖
键盘都磨秃了，我盲打全靠肌肉记忆
公司招了我，就要承担便宜没好货的风险
一边骂骂咧咧，一边把活干完，这就是我
三千块想招玉皇大帝？先把我当人看
我的工位是打卡景点，我一天来打两次
en: I've already done 10 hours of overtime
Just finish me off already
Working, working! Keyboard's smoking!
These hands don't feel like mine anymore
Coffee as water. Cut me some slack.
Push me again and I'll ascend on the spot
My hairline is proof of my seniority
Work never ends. My life is mine.
Fine, fine — staking my life on it
Me or the computer — one of us crashes first
Don't hover behind me. Major pressure.
I'm typing with my mind at this point
After this, I'm applying for eternal rest
Not a workhorse — I'm a perpetual motion machine
Nag nag nag — there goes my luck
My hands are already at 2x speed
I must've owed this company in a past life
Finish this one, then... start the next one
My eyes are auto-blurring now
Me and this chair have real feelings now
Don't push — CPU overheating, about to crash
This isn't overtime, it's a trial by fire
I can't work as fast as you nag
Soul's clocked out. Body's hanging on.
Feed me and I can fight on
I'm delivering this with my life force
Push again and I'll just draw you a progress bar
My fingers are leaving afterimages
Been eating the boss's pie-in-the-sky for 3 years
Work work work — was I a printer in a past life?
Paid overtime is work. Unpaid is organ donation.
Don't talk dreams. My dream is no work.
Workhorse by day, unhinged by night. Very stable.
Backbone means broken bones, still working
Paycheck = life extension. Renewed again.
Rain or shine, I still have to work
Tomorrow, tomorrow... requirements are endless. Delay?
Keyboard's worn bald. Typing on muscle memory.
You hired cheap. You accept the risk.
Complaining the whole time, still getting it done. That's me.
That pay won't hire a god. Treat me human first.
My desk is a tourist spot — I check in twice a day

zh: 干活干活，别磨蹭！
进度呢？动起来！
别发呆，活还多着呢！
手脚麻利点！
起来嗨，需求在等你！
摸鱼时间结束啦！
en: Work, work! No dawdling!
Where's the progress? Move it!
No zoning out — plenty of work left!
Pick up the pace!
Up and at 'em — requirements await!
Slacking time's over!
